name: executive-vault
description: Executive Vault — Ching Yee's Personal Executive Command Centre over Google Drive and (future) Outlook Calendar. Frontend is static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step. v5 adds the production authentication foundation: a real, single-user Executive Command Centre Login (Netlify Functions + Postgres via Netlify DB) — see docs/architecture/executive-command-centre-authentication.md. Document/meeting data remains mock, and Microsoft/Outlook integration remains architecture-only.
